statement: Radiotherapy with concomitant and adjuvant temozolomide extended median survival in newly diagnosed glioblastoma from 12.1 to 14.6 months, and two-year survival from 10% to 26%, compared with radiotherapy alone.

measurement.effect: +2.5 months median; 10% to 26% at two years

replication.note: Adopted worldwide as the standard of care and confirmed in subsequent cohorts.

limitations: the benefit is measured in months and no patient is cured

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
